name: intraday-equities-horizon-scan
notes: Wide-feature rank-IC scan over the universe horizon grid. Go/no-go knobs live in configs/universe.json. Lockbox unused.

universe.notes: The only market and science knob file. Add a candidate by editing this file plus the source configs; run documents do not restate names.

alpaca.notes: Historical SIP tape. root is the invoking cwd; run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

features.notes: Feature widths, holidays, emit grid, and reference residuals come from the universe file.

tradable.notes: IC is scored on tradable names only. Reference bars already contributed residuals.

scan.notes: Train selects features; val scores the curve. Anchors and SE bar are universe.horizon.

splits.notes: Chronological cuts with a one-day embargo. The latest six months are the lockbox (test); this scan stops at val_end.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd. One experiment so cadence and HPO runs compare in one UI.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
